script.intro: Does your head drift forward when you scroll?

sections.name: Deep neck
sections.say: Chin tucks wake up the deep neck muscles and pull your head back over your shoulders.

clips.shot: Full body side view (profile), standing tall, doing a chin tuck: the head glides straight back so the ears line up over the shoulders; the deep front neck muscles and upper trapezius glow
clips.move: chin tucks, the head gliding straight back and returning, chin level, 3 slow reps

clips.shot: Close-up side profile from the chest up, head pulled back in a chin tuck, neck long; the deep neck muscles glow intensely
clips.move: chin tucks, holding each one for a second at the back, 2 slow reps
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right
